author: marketing_c
protectedRevelations: Individual case verdicts, certainty index and pre-outcome toolkit

scenes.title: The moment before the verdict
scenes.viewerPurpose: Notice success stories cannot identify danger in advance Want to tell the difference while choices remain open
scenes.composition: Founder and tester face an unproven prototype
addOrChange: Keep the outcome unknown without a hero-fraud comparison.

cues.narration: Before the outcome, a visionary and a dangerously convinced founder can sound remarkably alike.
cues.visualAction: A confident presentation stands beside a blank measurement record.

cues.narration: Too Convinced to Stop asks how to tell the difference while it still matters.
cues.visualAction: Hold both viewpoints before the result exists.

scenes.title: Confidence buys time
scenes.viewerPurpose: Feel why ambition needs confidence and can be trapped by it Expect concrete stories beyond one startup
scenes.composition: An ambitious claim waits beside outstanding tests
addOrChange: Make the ledger an evidence record rather than a moral debt meter.

cues.narration: Inventors often need confidence before they have proof, but confidence can also hide a mistake.
cues.visualAction: Mark a missing test while the claim stays confident.

cues.narration: The book follows laboratories, companies, and historical movements through that dangerous interval.
cues.visualAction: Move between laboratory and company settings with the same unanswered check.

scenes.title: Which evidence counts
scenes.viewerPurpose: Follow inventors meeting facts they do not want Notice who can still challenge an expensive belief
scenes.composition: Historical cases are examined before their outcomes
addOrChange: Replace judge and veil with Edison, Ford and startup case notes.

cues.narration: Edison, Ford, and modern startups meet evidence that does not fit what they hoped.
cues.visualAction: Open the evidence that challenged each hopeful story.

cues.narration: The question is who can challenge a belief once money and identity depend on it.
cues.visualAction: Keep an objection visible beside funding and founder commitments.

scenes.title: Who can call a halt
scenes.viewerPurpose: Resist simply sorting people by how the story ended Ask who can help an ambitious idea learn or stop
scenes.composition: A tester can reach a real pause control beside the record
addOrChange: Leave authority to use it as the question, not a solved prescription.

cues.narration: These stories ask more of us than simply sorting founders into heroes and frauds.
cues.visualAction: Return to evidence instead of assigning a moral category.

cues.narration: What would let an ambitious wager learn, and who could stop it if it cannot?
cues.visualAction: Hold control, record and people bearing the cost together.
